title: Port the door/container auth-challenge and cold-start-budget parity checks into ticfac
body: Deleting cloud/factory from this repo (tick 3r2) removed the TypeScript half of two cross-repo parity tests that used to live in internal/sandbox: TestTheDoorAndTheContainerAgreeAboutTheChallenge (git_door_test.go, checked cloud/factory/src/credentials.ts's Basic-auth challenge against cloud/sandbox/common.sh's expectation of it) and TestWorkerProbeBudgetCoversTheMeasuredColdStart (benchmark_test.go, checked cloud/factory/src/worker-dispatch.ts's COLD_START_BENCHMARK_MS/FANOUT_DEGRADATION_FACTOR constants against a committed cold-start benchmark artifact). Both were trimmed to their local-only half or removed in tick 3r2's commit. ticfac now owns the TypeScript side of both contracts and should re-establish the cross-repo check, most likely by vendoring or fetching the relevant cloud/sandbox files the way the old test vendored/read cloud/factory's.
